name: GitHub-Release-Monitor
description: A powerful, self-hostable application to automatically monitor GitHub repository releases and receive instant email notifications. Keep track of your favorite projects without manually checking for updates.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Specify the path to the data directory.

variables.name: Auth Secret
variables.description: A long, random string (at least 32 characters) used to encrypt session cookies. You can generate one using: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: The username for logging into the application.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: The password for logging into the application.

variables.name: GitHub Access Token
variables.description: A GitHub Personal Access Token to increase the API rate limit. A token with no scopes is sufficient.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: The timezone for the container (e.g., Europe/London). Affects log timestamps and date formatting.

variables.name: Mail Port
variables.description: The port for your SMTP server (e.g., 587 or 465).

variables.name: Mail Password
variables.description: The password or app token for SMTP authentication.

variables.name: Mail From Address
variables.description: The email address that notifications will be sent from.

variables.name: Mail To Address
variables.description: The email address that will receive the notifications.

variables.name: Mail Host
variables.description: The hostname or IP address of your SMTP server.
